title: Check a marker's reply against its criteria
statement: Check that a model marker returns exactly one verdict per authored criterion, and treat a missing, invented, duplicated or malformed verdict as a marking failure, never a pass or miss.
detail: A Grade 5 open answer was rejected although it was the course's own supported answer, byte-identical to its reveal (`grade3-reading/ui-audit-2026-09-08/BEAD-REGISTER.json`, line 72). Replaying the exact request through the real scoring route returned a positive judgment under an invented criterion ID, which the route counted as a miss. Once the route accepted only the exact authored criterion IDs, each with one complete boolean, malformed output stopped becoming a learner's wrong answer and the unchanged answer was accepted (line 84). The recount repair applies the rule from the other side: a required criterion whose verdict is missing, duplicated with conflicting verdicts or malformed cannot pass (line 197).
against: The live failure's raw reply was lost, so its cause rests on a reproduction: "Its internal cause is not yet isolated because the original HTTP/model response was not captured." (`grade3-reading/ui-audit-2026-09-08/BEAD-REGISTER.json`, line 72). The closure keeps that limit and records no human or deployment acceptance (line 84).
